cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:74f.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. The Chef Instructor, Pastry contributes to the success of a Sur La Table store by inspiring customers on all points of their culinary journey. The Chef Instructor blends culinary talent and teaching skills to support the Resident Chef in driving business results. The Chef Instructor reports to the Resident Chef.
responsibilities: Models and directs employees to ensure customer service standards are met.
Delivers an exceptional cooking class experience at every class using recipes and game plans provided.
Stays informed by maintaining product knowledge, accesses available training and seeks out additional resources when necessary.
Ensures high standards of sanitation and cleanliness are maintained throughout the experience. Keeps work area and guest areas clean and organized.

Works as a part of a high-performing team to achieve store’s sales plan. Strives to achieve individual and/or class sales goals.

Seeks opportunities to increase cooking class and retail sales.
Records time worked, accurately and according to SLT policy.
Anticipates and solves problems by taking decisive action, follows up with Resident Chef.
Demonstrates exceptional verbal and written communication skills with employees, customers, field management and corporate office.
May handle, serve, and pour liquor, wine and beer and/or mix ingredients, such as liquor, soda, water and etc. in order to prepare cocktails and other drinks.
Additional responsibilities as assigned by Resident Chef.
qualifications: Culinary degree in Pastry or equivalent experience considered in lieu of degree.
Demonstrated successful teaching and training experience.
Valid Food Handlers and/or Food Managers Certification.
Must be at least 21 years old.
Familiarity with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Proven ability to drive sales and motivate teams.

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Director/Senior Director, Compensation
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Flagship Pioneering is a bioplatform innovation company that invents and builds platform companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps. Those big leaps in human health and sustainability exponentially accelerate scientific progress in areas ranging from cancer detection and treatment to nature-positive agriculture. What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our scientific founders, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and transform for the benefit of people and planet. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Position Overview: Flagship Pioneering is seeking a highly skilled and strategic compensation leader to oversee the design, management, and execution of non-executive compensation programs across our ecosystem. This role sits within the Total Rewards team and is responsible for Flagship's internal operations as well as its Series A and B Portfolio Companies globally. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in broad-based compensation and market practices, combined with strong cross-functional leadership and executive presence. This is a pivotal leadership role with exposure to all facets of Total Rewards, including executive compensation, equity programs, and global compensation design. While the current focus is broad-based compensation, the right candidate will demonstrate the potential to grow into broader leadership within the Total Rewards function over time. Key Responsibilities: ​ Compensation Program Leadership: ​ Design, implement, and continuously refine broad-based compensation programs across a global footprint, including geographic differentials, salary structures, job leveling, and bonus frameworks. Lead annual compensation review cycles (merit, bonus, promotion) in close partnership with HR Business Partners, Finance, and Talent Acquisition. Collaborate with recruiting teams to craft competitive, market-aligned offers while maintaining internal equity. Conduct ongoing market benchmarking and compensation analysis, leveraging tools such as Radford and Pave. Maintain and evolve our pay transparency and pay equity frameworks across the organization. Strategic Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: ​ Partner with executive compensation, equity, and benefits leads to ensure cohesive Total Rewards strategy. Serve as a thought partner to HRBPs and senior business leaders, providing guidance on compensation practices, offer structures, and policy interpretation. Prepare and deliver insights, reports, and recommendations to senior leadership. ​ Global Compensation & Compliance: ​ Maintain deep awareness of compensation regulations across key geographies ​ Develop and maintain localization frameworks to ensure regional competitiveness and compliance. Advise on global mobility compensation matters and cross-border assignments. ​ Team and Operational Excellence Manage compensation tools, systems, and workflows to ensure accurate, efficient program delivery. Support compensation-related aspects of M&A and new company creation initiatives. Qualification

Initial contractor engagement with planned conversion to full-time employment pending performance and mutual fit. CVS Health's Analytics & Behavior Change (A&BC) organization leverages advanced analytics, machine learning, and a hypothesis-driven approach to transform data into actionable, customer-centric insights across all CVS Health businesses — serving 100+ million customers. As Senior Manager of Data Partnerships & Monetization, you will own the strategy and execution of CVS Health's external data licensing portfolio while serving as the internal authority on strategic third-party data assets. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role requiring someone equally credible with external healthcare analytics and technology partners, internal engineering teams, and senior business stakeholders — and who can operate with a high degree of autonomy. External Data Partnerships, Licensing & Commercialization (~60%) CVS Health licenses data products to a growing portfolio of external partners — spanning healthcare analytics and technology organizations, with emerging interest from broader industries. You will serve as the internal owner and subject matter expert for these data products: driving adoption, enabling new use cases, and ensuring the data delivers maximum value across the enterprise. • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal analytics and product teams seeking to leverage external data assets, advising on applicability, limitations, and best use cases • Maintain accessible documentation, FAQs, and guidelines to enable self-service adoption across teams • Partner with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to support onboarding, integration, and ongoing use of external data assets • Monitor data quality, coverage, and performance, proactively identifying and resolving issues in partnership with in

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0d2920dc-0054-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Luxury Reservation Sales Consultant - Bilingual based in Canada. Join a customer-focused luxury travel environment where every conversation can shape a guest’s experience from the very first interaction. You’ll assist travelers in English and French with reservations across a portfolio of renowned luxury hotels and resorts. The role combines consultative sales, hospitality, active listening, and personalized service to turn travel aspirations into memorable stays. You’ll recommend rooms, suites, packages, and premium options based on each guest’s individual needs and preferences. As a trusted first point of contact, you’ll have the opportunity to build loyalty through warm, authentic, and thoughtful interactions. You’ll work alongside a diverse, multicultural team in an environment that values inclusion, sustainability, and professional growth. After comprehensive paid onsite training, the role offers the flexibility of working remotely from home in eligible Canadian provinces. Answer inbound reservation calls and assist guests in both English and French with room, suite, and package bookings across luxury hospitality properties. Listen actively to understand guest preferences, travel plans, and expectations, then provide personalized recommendations that enhance their stay. Use consultative selling techniques to confidently present premium room, suite, package, and experience options when appropriate. Create warm, genuine, and memorable guest interactions by adapting your communication style and recommendations to each traveler. Provide accurate, efficient, and professional service while navigating multiple reservation and customer service systems. Represent responsible, ethical, sustainable, and guest-focused hospitality practices in every interaction. Make informed decisions, take initiative, resolve guest needs effectively, and contribute positively to team performance. Build lasting guest relationships by delivering a consistently high-quality experience that encourages satisfaction and loyalty. Requirements: Professional-level fluency in both English and French , with the ability to communicate confidently with guests in both languages. Strong verbal communication, listening, interpersonal, and customer service skills, with the professionalism expected in a luxury hospitality environment. Experience and/or education in hospitality, tourism, sales, customer service, or contact centre operations is preferred. A genuine passion for travel, luxury experiences, hospitality, and helping others. Confidence, initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to make decisions while working independently and as part of a team. Ability to navigate multiple software systems simultaneously while maintaining an efficient, personalized, and engaging guest experience. Must be legally authorized to work full-time in Canada. Must be available for a full-time, permanent schedule primarily from 6:30 PM to 3:00 AM , including weekends and holidays, with periodic weekends off. Must be able to complete 4.5 weeks of fully paid onsite training in Moncton ; travel and accommodation are provided for qualified candidates. For the remote portion of the role, must have a suitable home workspace and a reliable high-speed wired internet connection ; wireless and satellite connections are not permitted. Benefits: $21.35/hour , including a $1.50/hour premium for French-language proficiency. jobgether-jobgether:lever:25037b8a-8cc7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Member Services Processing Specialist based in the United States. This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity supporting a federally administered healthcare program with a meaningful mission. The role focuses on reviewing and processing member applications, certifications, transfers, appeals, and supporting documentation. You’ll play an important role in ensuring members receive accurate, timely, and compliant service throughout their program experience. The position combines careful documentation review and data processing with direct communication with members, providers, and internal teams. You’ll work within established procedures while contributing to quality assurance, cross-training, and continuous process improvements. Success requires strong attention to detail, service orientation, adaptability, and the ability to manage competing priorities. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized professional seeking to build experience in healthcare operations and mission-driven service delivery. Member application processing: Process enrollment applications, certifications, transfers, appeals, designated representative appointments, updates, and other service requests in accordance with program policies, standard operating procedures, and federal requirements. Documentation review: Examine member-submitted documentation for completeness, accuracy, eligibility, and compliance, determining whether materials satisfy applicable program requirements. Data entry and case management: Enter and update information accurately within member services systems, digital mail center tools, entry portals, and intelligent document processing platforms, ensuring documentation is properly routed and processed on time. Case documentation: Maintain accurate case notes, records, and supporting documentation to facilitate program reviews, compliance requirements, and audit readiness. Member and stakeholder support: Communicate professionally with members, healthcare providers, and internal stakeholders regarding documentation requirements, missing information, processing status, and other service-related questions. Escalation management: Identify complex or ambiguous cases and escalate them appropriately to the Member Services Processing Supervisor for guidance and resolution. Privacy and compliance: Protect sensitive information by adhering to HIPAA requirements, privacy policies, and procedures governing personally identifiable and protected health information. Quality assurance: Identify processing errors, recurring trends, and opportunities for improvement, sharing observations and recommendations with leadership. Cross-training: Participate in training and process updates to provide effective support across enrollment, record maintenance, appeals routing, member correspondence, and related workflows. Continuous improvement: Contribute ideas and feedback regarding workflow challenges, system issues, process inefficiencies, and potential operational enhancements. Requirements Education: High school diploma or equivalent required. Experience: 1–3 years of experience in processing, administrative support, data entry, customer service, healthcare operations, or a related operational environment. Documentation skills: Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to review and analyze documentation against established requirements. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with members, providers, colleagues, and other stakeholders. Process discipline: Ability to follow detailed procedures accurately, maintain consistent documentation, meet deadlines, and operate within established compliance requirements. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c54302e3-f913-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Real Estate Maintenance Coordinator based in Mexico. As a Real Estate Maintenance Coordinator, you’ll oversee property maintenance projects from initial request through completion, ensuring issues are resolved efficiently and professionally. You’ll communicate daily with tenants, vendors, property stakeholders, and business owners in both English and Spanish. The role combines customer service, project coordination, problem-solving, and detailed administrative organization. You’ll manage work orders, maintain project dashboards, track repair progress, and ensure stakeholders receive timely updates. Success in this position requires someone who can work independently, prioritize multiple requests, and take initiative when unexpected issues arise. You’ll work remotely with a distributed team and use a range of property management, project management, and communication platforms. This is a hands-on opportunity for an organized, proactive professional who enjoys helping people and improving operational processes. Manage maintenance and property-related projects from start to finish, ensuring timely completion and effective resolution of issues. Coordinate work orders between tenants, vendors, property stakeholders, and other relevant parties. Communicate professionally and courteously with tenants, vendors, business owners, and company leaders through email, phone, text, and virtual platforms. Maintain and create project dashboards using tools such as Google Sheets, ClickUp, or comparable platforms, ensuring information, notes, and status updates remain accurate and current. Monitor repair progress and update work-order statuses within property management software. Respond to emails and service requests promptly, acknowledging requests within 24 hours. Proactively identify problems, determine appropriate solutions, and make recommendations for process or operational improvements. Build positive relationships with stakeholders through active listening, clear communication, professionalism, and a helpful approach. Use new technology platforms confidently and adapt quickly to unfamiliar software and workflows. Take ownership of assigned projects and follow through without requiring constant supervision. Strong Spanish and English communication skills, both written and verbal. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and stakeholder requests while maintaining attention to detail. Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to keep dashboards, records, and updates accurate. Full proficiency with AppFolio is required. Working knowledge of Buildium is an advantage. Familiarity with project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or Microsoft Project is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to maintain professional yet friendly relationships and communicate effectively with different audiences. Comfortable learning new technology and adapting quickly to new software platforms. Previous experience in property management, real estate, hospitality, or hotel operations is helpful but not required. Able to work independently in a fully remote environment. Must have a personal computer suitable for remote work and a reliable internet connection. Benefits Fully remote contract position based in Mexico. Opportunity to work in an international, distributed environment with English- and Spanish-speaking stakeholders. Flexible schedule that may align with COT, EST, or PST business hours , depending on client requirements. Training on required technology platform

triedgeinvestments-triedge-investments:a.title: Senior Product Manager
triedgeinvestments-triedge-investments:a.description: At TriEdge Investments, we build world-class technology to drive value creation across a portfolio of 30+ companies. Our approach is deliberate and staged: we start by delivering bespoke solutions that unlock performance and move EBITDA; we then scale those wins through platform tools that can be deployed across the portfolio; ultimately, we’re building an intelligent platform that redefines how private equity enables value creation at scale. As a Senior Product Manager, you will help lead the next stage of that evolution: taking high-impact, operator-led problems and turning them into zero-to-one AI products that work in the field, earn adoption, and can scale beyond a single customer or use case. This is not a traditional product management role where you sit between stakeholders and engineering to manage a roadmap. You will be embedded with operators, executives, engineers, and designers to identify the right problems, define the product strategy, drive pilots, prove product-market fit at the customer level, and help generalize successful solutions into reusable products across the portfolio. We are looking for someone who has built new products from the ground up, ideally in AI, ML, automation, or workflow-heavy environments. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, working closely with technical teams, and understanding the realities of implementation, rollout, adoption, and change management inside complex businesses. What You’ll Do - Own zero-to-one development of AI-native products across TriEdge portfolio companies and select partners, from concept through MVP, requirements, roadmap, and success metrics - Work directly with operators and executives to identify high-leverage problems and define where software creates measurable impact - Partner with engineering, design, and data teams to rapidly prototype, test, and ship products in real operating environments - Own implementation end to end, including rollout, adoption, and change management inside a customer's existing environment, not just requirements gathering - Drive customer discovery through interviews, workflow observation, pilot design, and adoption tracking - Prove product-market fit with one customer, then generalize and reposition the product to scale across other clients, portfolio companies, and markets, deciding where it stays bespoke versus becomes a repeatable platform - Define success metrics tied to adoption, throughput, cost, reliability, and revenue impact, and partner with leadership to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities About You - 10+ years in product management or product leadership, with meaningful ownership of zero-to-one development, ideally in startup, growth-stage, or highly ambiguous environments - Hands-on experience taking products into live operating environments, including implementation, rollout, change management, and post-launch iteration, not just building and handing off - Deep experience with AI-native products; ML, NLP, and intelligent workflow products all count - Strong product judgment: identifying real user pain, defining an MVP, testing adoption, and assessing whether a product can scale beyond one customer - Able to work directly with engineers, write clear requirements, and drive execution without a heavily structured product org - Sharp customer discovery instincts, separating stated needs from true product opportunities - Commercial and analytical mindset: market size, repeatability, positioning, and using data to evaluate pilots and quantify impact - Excellent communication, with the ability to align executives, operators, and cross-functional teams - High ownership, bias toward action, and a low-ego, pragmatic approach in fast-moving ambiguous settings - Bachelor’s degree minimum Nice to Have - Experience building products in operationally complex industries such as healthcare, financial services, logistics, revenue cycle management, or workforce optimization - Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise
